definitions.explanation: Describes food that is spicy or hot (chili-hot, not temperature-hot).
Can also mean salty, though しょっぱい (shoppai) is more common for 'salty' in eastern Japan.

examples.japanese: この{料理|りょうり}は{辛|から}いです。
{辛|から}いものが{食|た}べられますか。
ちょっと{辛|から}すぎます。

notes: 辛い can mean both 'spicy' and 'salty,' though 'spicy' is the more common meaning. Don't confuse with 辛い (つらい), which means 'painful/hard'—same kanji, different reading and meaning. Conjugation: 辛くない (negative), 辛かった (past).
